summary:
Implementation plan for Salary Saathi UX, security, AI speed, and state-preservation upgrades:
1. Dynamic theme palette support on the launch Splash Screen (zero-flash cold start) and matching themed App Launcher Icon variants + in-app brand emblems.
2. App PIN Lock attempt limit: 5 wrong attempts trigger a live 30-second cooldown timer with direct Security Recovery PIN reset.
3. Home screen header and quick-action layout fixes eliminating greeting, date/cycle pill, and button label clipping.
4. Horizontal swipeable tabs (HorizontalPager) across all 4 sections of Legal, Privacy & Safety synced with the top chip bar.
5. Unclipped Verified badge on MD Azad's circular developer avatar.
6. Direct installable APK sharing via FileProvider when tapping Share App.
7. Occasional non-spammy Smart Usage & Spending notifications (strictly capped at max 1 insight per active day).
8. Ultra-fast AI Saathi streaming replies by removing thinking/token bottlenecks and pre-warming model sessions.
9. Full screen & sub-screen state preservation when backgrounding via the Home button and resuming (with or without PIN lock).
